causal_link_thinning_no_go.geometry: unit coordinate-time truncated future cone in 3+1 Minkowski
causal_link_thinning_no_go.acceptance_rule: given actual causal link, retain with probability exp(-alpha*rho*V_interval), alpha>=0 fixed as rho changes
causal_link_thinning_no_go.note: actual links have empty intervals; rho*V_interval here is the *embedding/continuum* Alexandrov volume, not the observed number of intermediate elements. This thinning is NOT intrinsic order-only.
causal_link_thinning_no_go.asymptotic_exact: E_retained ~ pi sqrt(6/(1+alpha))*sqrt(rho) for any fixed alpha>=0
causal_link_thinning_no_go.integral: pi rho int_0^1 ds exp[-(1+alpha)*rho*pi*s²/24] [sqrt(1-s)-s log((1+sqrt(1-s))/sqrt(s))]
causal_link_thinning_no_go.limits: Positive nonvanishing density-independent link-thinning profiles still give growing null-cone link degree in this region. This does not exclude cancellation-based nonlocal kernels, density-dependent suppression or other intrinsic locality prescriptions.

CCR_energy_vacuum_selection.result: Each positive omega selects a unique pure Gaussian oscillator ground state, but different supplied Hamiltonians select different physical vacua with identical CCR. A causal exchange TOE must derive the time generator/energy functional, not simply impose minimization.
CCR_energy_vacuum_selection.scope: Elementary harmonic oscillator, not a curved-spacetime Hadamard state, a Born rule or an interacting causal quantum gravity solution.
